expect_red: Accept writes the proposed face, at the proposed end, as a `bound` event naming the proposal and recorded as the reviewer

mutations.contract: An Accept is a `bound` event carrying `ratifies: <proposal id>`; without it the fold cannot close the proposal and the face reads as proposed and bound at once.
mutations.note: Dropping `ratifies` still writes a plausible binding -- which is why it needs pinning.
